svg.title: SPRII Figure 1
svg.desc: All panels are schematic. Relations between observed histories guide context learning. Formation, fixed-reader Use and conditional Value are separate questions. Use compares spring predictions for the same input and forecast time; no measured trajectories or parameter labels are used.
